label: Dapr: inbound service with response
info: Exposes a service method other Dapr apps can invoke through this sidecar. The Function node must mutate and return the same message (never build a new one) so msg.dapr.responseId reaches the dapr response node. Set the connection node's Dapr host/port and app port before deploying, then invoke it from another app-id as POST /orders/echo.

name: build response
